profileEvidence.summary: Spunky and agile in a firsthand account, Emma offers a glimpse of the Yo-Chon, a Bichon Frise–Yorkshire Terrier cross. At 14 months she was described as full-grown and keen to jump over obstacles, though she stayed on a lead because she would run off. A separate encounter records her caution around a larger Boxer puppy; her owners reported that she played with a neighbour’s adult Golden Retriever.
